name: Agentic Plugin Marketplace
summary: Marketplace of 94 composable agentic plugins — 202 agents, 183 skills, 105 commands — for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.
description: Production-ready agentic workflow building blocks from one Markdown source: 94 composable plugins containing 202 agents, 183 skills, 105 slash commands and 16 multi-agent orchestrators, installable into Claude Code and consumed natively by OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, the Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot and Pi. Installing a plugin loads only its components into context, and a three-layer plugin-eval framework (static, LLM judge, Monte Carlo) measures plugin and skill quality.
contains: one Markdown source shipped to seven harnesses
tiered model strategy per task tier
plugin-eval quality framework (static, LLM judge, Monte Carlo)
external memory (Pensyve) and security (HOL Guard) integrations
